Hi Meena / Jordan —

Thanks — looping in the PDM/PSM intake process here so we can accelerate pairing with AWS. Quick answers to Meena's questions:

1) Data residency: we will request that the ACE pairing and co-sell plan target us-west-2 for the pilot. That is standard and should be acceptable; AWS typically confirms region mapping during intake.

2) Hosted access to test data: not required for a surface-level pilot. For model tuning or deeper integration we sometimes request a sanitized sample (S3 URL with limited access or a subset upload). We'll mark that as optional in the intake.

3) Intake packet: Jordan's attached POC_scope.pdf is perfect — I've added a short checklist to the package (artifact list, preferred region, pilot timeline). I'll submit the intake to AWS ACE ops once you share the registration confirmation ID.

Available times: Fri 12/4 10:00-10:30 PT works for me and Aditya. I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff and include AWS ACE ops (aws-ace-ops@amazon.com) so they can triage the pairing. Calendar invite to follow.
